text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wah... I feel like I could just ride the 
wind like a piece of dandelion fluff...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um... Goddesses! Thank you so very much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best to live up to the 
Goddess's cheers, so please keep watching 
over me!
